cultural_scope_locks: 2016 authors argue for general day clock; no assertion every contemporary Momostenango/Zunil daykeeper adopts same birth-time rule
Sacred Cholq'ij/Tzolk'in sign (260) and solar Ab'/Haab' months (365) turn over at different times in the investigated interpretation; never copy sacred date offset to solar calendar
Highland Ab' calendar has separate ~40-day month-year alignment relative to Classic Lowland system; do not infer lowland Haab from highland yearbearer
Day sign number and name are coupled for traditional use; pooled Noj (all numbers 1-13) remains a MODERN experimental simplification to be content-reviewed, not the exact historic method
Existing dictionary of Zunil day names is transliteration crosswalk only; cultural characterization remains independent
Dated calendar agreement is engineering/source parity, not validation of person's traits
No participant-specific calculation or sensitive birth inputs committed into public repository
